content.title: Message from the Future | Private Warning Verified by the Outside World
content.summary: Use a private recording device to first give a warning from the future self, and then allow the subject to actively turn to a verifiable external window; first use an abnormal version of a familiar city to prove the time misalignment, and finally allow greater sky evidence to appear, upgrading the warning from information to a real threat.

quick_start.input_format: Current subject + future self-information + active external verification + local future environment + larger-scale threats
quick_start.recommended_input: In the original polar observatory, a young cartographer opened a frost-sealed cylinder. The date of the cylinder was eighty years later than the current one. The gloves and map table were clearly visible. The young cartographer left the map table and walked towards the only slit in the observation dome. The table, cylinder and slit remained continuous. After the research tower was established, a huge black ring shadow crossed the aurora. The cartographer, slit, tower group and ring shadow were preserved at the same time. No explanation or attack was given.
required_anchors: Establish one private proof record with a visibly impossible future origin.
Bind the record to a future version or unmistakable continuation of the present subject.
First reveal a familiar environment in a clearly altered future state.
Introduce one larger external anomaly only after the environment confirms the time shift, and end unresolved.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Use a private recording device to first give a warning from the future self, and then allow the subject to actively turn to a verifiable external window; first use an abnormal version of a familiar city to prove the time misalignment, and finally allow greater sky evidence to appear, upgrading the warning from information to a real threat.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Begin with a private record that is visibly dated or sourced from a future version of the subject. Keep its message bounded inside the proof device, then make the present subject move to one stable external aperture for verification. Reveal a familiar environment in an impossible future state, and only after that first confirmation introduce a much larger external anomaly that reframes the warning as an immediate unresolved threat.

invariants.rule: Establish one private proof record with a visibly impossible future origin.
invariants.ablation_failure: A vague mysterious message lacks temporal proof.

invariants.rule: Bind the record to a future version or unmistakable continuation of the present subject.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unrelated messenger weakens the identity bridge.

invariants.rule: Move the present subject from the private record to one stable external aperture.
invariants.purpose: Turns information into an observable test.
invariants.ablation_failure: A cut directly to spectacle removes the verification action.

invariants.rule: First reveal a familiar environment in a clearly altered future state.
invariants.purpose: Provides a local confirmation before escalation.
invariants.ablation_failure: Skipping local confirmation makes the warning ungrounded.

invariants.rule: Introduce one larger external anomaly only after the environment confirms the time shift, and end unresolved.
invariants.purpose: Escalates evidence into threat without overexplaining it.
invariants.ablation_failure: An early giant reveal consumes the evidence ladder.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source smartphone and MESSAGE FROM 2100 interface
the source young and elderly men
Dubai apartment and futuristic Dubai skyline
the source exact future-video-to-window shot order

instantiations.concept: At an original polar observatory, a young cartographer opens a sealed frost-cylinder stamped with a date eighty years ahead and sees an elderly version of herself in a tiny volumetric archive. She crosses to the dome slit, finds the familiar ice shelf replaced by luminous towers, then a continent-scale ring shadow rotates across the aurora.
